clue.text: Business arrangement is sealed by Italian, someone unrealistic

indicators.note: what is sealed by something has that thing closing it in on both sides

parts.note: It is short for Italian vermouth, as in gin and it
a deal is an arrangement struck in business
taken as written

explanation.surface: An Italian firm closes a business deal, yet someone involved is dreaming.
explanation.walkthrough: DEAL and IS together sit inside IT, the crossword shorthand for Italian vermouth.
explanation.definitionFit: An idealist pursues perfect principles and is often thought impractical, a person out of touch with hard reality.

clue.text: Verbal communication sure seems odd after musical party

indicators.note: a word that seems odd looks out of shape, so its letters are put into a new order

parts.note: a disco is a party with dancing to recorded music
these letters rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone finds the chatter odd after a night at a dance party.
explanation.walkthrough: 'after' places the rearranged letters behind the party word.
explanation.definitionFit: Discourse is formal spoken or written exchange of ideas, such as talk, debate or a lecture.

clue.text: Spy, adult bloke

parts.note: A is the film-rating abbreviation for adult
a gent is a man, a fellow

explanation.surface: A terse description of a spy: a grown-up man.
explanation.definitionFit: A secret agent is a person employed to gather intelligence covertly for a government.

clue.text: Pray, learning to pursue devil

parts.note: an imp is a little devil
lore is traditional knowledge or learning

explanation.surface: A plea to pray, using one's learning to hunt down the devil.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to pursue' puts learning behind the devil, as a chaser comes after its quarry.
explanation.definitionFit: To pray in the older sense is to beg or entreat earnestly, which is exactly to implore.

clue.text: Husband boarding plane perhaps — he and two others?

indicators.note: someone boarding a vehicle gets inside it

parts.note: the plane is a kind of tree, hence 'perhaps'
H is the abbreviation for husband

explanation.surface: A husband gets on an aeroplane, and with him two other passengers make a group.
explanation.walkthrough: The plane is not an aircraft but the tree; the husband goes inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: One person plus two more makes a group numbering three, a playful way of defining the number.

clue.text: Quietly push baby's conveyance

parts.note: p, piano, is the musical direction for quietly
to ram is to push forcefully

explanation.surface: Instruction to push the baby's buggy along quietly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'push' looks like part of the picture of wheeling the baby, but it supplies the second chunk.
explanation.definitionFit: A pram, short for perambulator, is a wheeled carriage in which an infant is pushed about.

clue.text: Tale cop spun out — it may stink

indicators.note: a story spun out is twisted and embroidered, so its letters get reworked

parts.note: seven letters to rearrange

explanation.surface: A policeman embellishes a story, and the result smells fishy.
explanation.definitionFit: The polecat is a weasel-like animal notorious for the foul smell it releases when threatened.

clue.text: Get rid of a cross employee finally

parts.note: taken as written
an X is a cross shape

indicators.note: finally points to the end of the word, so only its closing letter is kept

parts.note: the final letter of employee

explanation.surface: Dismiss an employee who has finally become angry.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cross' reads as angry but is the letter shaped like a cross.
explanation.definitionFit: To axe something is to cut or abolish it, informally to sack or eliminate it.

clue.text: Name of woman in dungarees, messy

indicators.note: in says the letters sit inside the words that follow

parts.note: running across the end of one word and start of the next

explanation.surface: Some woman's work overalls are in a mess.
explanation.definitionFit: Esme is a girl's given name, as in the literary heroine of Salinger's story.

clue.text: Fatter doorkeeper, about 51

indicators.note: about means going around, so one piece encloses the other

parts.note: a porter guards a door or gate
LI is 51 in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: A doorman around 51 years old has put on weight.
explanation.definitionFit: Portly means stout or rotund, so its comparative describes someone stouter or heavier.

clue.text: Put off job, one going after power

parts.note: a post is a position of employment
P is the symbol for power in physics
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone delays a job because another person is chasing power.
explanation.walkthrough: 'going after' places the single word behind the power letter, both following the job.
explanation.definitionFit: To put off an event is to delay it to a later time, which is to postpone it.

clue.text: Cover animal found by lake

parts.note: a cow is a farm animal
L is the map abbreviation for lake

explanation.surface: Someone covers an animal they came upon beside a lake.
explanation.definitionFit: A cowl is a hood or covering, as worn by monks or fitted over a chimney.

clue.text: Bread, complete lunch in itself?

parts.note: whole means entire, complete
lunch is a meal
surface padding: the bread alone would make a full lunch

explanation.surface: Bread so filling that it makes a full lunch on its own.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark admits that the bread, eaten alone, would be a complete lunch.
explanation.definitionFit: Wholemeal bread is made from flour using the entire grain, so the word names a type of loaf.

clue.text: Break-up affected a man fretting about love

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the rearranged letters wrap around the next piece
affected means disturbed or put out of its normal state, so the letters are reworked

parts.note: twelve letters to rearrange
love is zero in tennis, shaped like O

explanation.surface: A break-up has left a man worrying about love.
explanation.definitionFit: Fragmentation is the process of breaking into pieces, a splitting apart or break-up.

clue.text: Instrument of execution — girl's getting depressed inside

indicators.note: getting here means receiving, so the girl's word takes the next piece within it

parts.note: gal is a girl, plus the S of the possessive
low means depressed in spirits

explanation.surface: A girl feels miserable at the sight of the scaffold.
explanation.definitionFit: The gallows is the frame from which condemned people were hanged, so a device for executing them.

clue.text: Strange comet — it is treated as significant symbol

indicators.note: strange means odd or out of the ordinary, so the letters fall into an unusual order

parts.note: seven letters to rearrange

explanation.surface: An odd comet is regarded as a sign or portent.
explanation.definitionFit: A totem is an emblem revered by a group, so a totemic thing is regarded as a revered emblem.

clue.text: Inventor entertained by Nobel laureate

indicators.note: something entertained by guests is held inside, so the letters lie within the next words

parts.note: the letters span the end of the first word and start of the second

explanation.surface: An inventor is hosted by a prize-winner.
explanation.definitionFit: Alexander Graham Bell was the inventor credited with the telephone.

clue.text: Things to eat a little piggy found in containers

indicators.note: found in means located inside, so these pieces go within another

parts.note: pots are containers
taken as written
from the nursery rhyme 'This little piggy', counted on the toes

explanation.surface: Food scraps for a small pig turn up in some bins.
explanation.walkthrough: In the nursery rhyme 'This little piggy went to market', each piggy is a toe.
explanation.definitionFit: Potatoes are starchy tubers eaten as a vegetable, a very general kind of food.

clue.text: Completely heartless partner seen outside port earlier

indicators.note: seen outside means placed around, so it encloses the next word
removing the whole heart leaves just the outermost letters of the word

parts.note: first and last letters of partner
Rio de Janeiro is a port city

explanation.surface: A cold-hearted partner was spotted outside the harbour beforehand.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Completely' matters: not just the middle letter goes, but all of the inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Prior means coming before in time, so earlier in order or date.

clue.text: Number protecting a king captured

indicators.note: protecting something means standing around it, so one word shields the other inside

parts.note: ten is a number
A as written plus K, the chess abbreviation for king

explanation.surface: A chess scene: pieces guarding a king, which is nevertheless taken.
explanation.definitionFit: Taken as a past participle means seized or caught, the same as captured.

clue.text: I spot men developing unfair recruitment process?

indicators.note: something developing changes its form, so the letters are reworked

parts.note: eight letters to rearrange

explanation.surface: A recruiter notices men getting on and suspects an unfair hiring process.
explanation.definitionFit: Nepotism is favouring relatives when giving out jobs, a biased way of choosing staff.

clue.text: Greek character had turned up

indicators.note: in a down clue, turned up means read from the bottom upwards

parts.note: had a meal, as in 'had dinner'

explanation.surface: A Greek person has arrived after eating.
explanation.definitionFit: Eta is the seventh letter of the Greek alphabet, a character in the written sense.

clue.text: Enthusiastic expression of grief

definitions.meaning: second meaning: a wailing lament for the dead

explanation.surface: An eager outpouring of mourning.
explanation.definitionFit: The adjective means eager; the noun is an Irish wailing lament sung over the dead.

clue.text: Permit the old man to join ship

parts.note: pa is father, the old man
SS is steamship

explanation.surface: Permission for an elderly father to board a vessel.
explanation.definitionFit: A pass is a document granting permission to enter or travel, a permit.

clue.text: Bit of money in bank a little while back

indicators.note: in means placed inside, so the coin goes within the next word

parts.note: to bank on is to rely on
a cent is a small coin

explanation.surface: A coin was deposited in a bank not long ago.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bank' is the verb, as in bank on someone.
explanation.definitionFit: Recently means at a time not long past, lately or of late.
